name: android.permission.CAMERA
description: Allows access to the device camera, can be used for spying or recording.

name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
description: Allows recording of audio; sensitive for privacy.

name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
description: Keeps the device awake or prevents it from sleeping.

name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
description: Allows apps to display overlays on top of other apps; can be used for tapjacking or hiding UI elements.

name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
description: Allows control over Bluetooth settings and discovery of nearby devices.

name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
description: Allows changing system settings such as volume; not very powerful.

name: android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
description: Very powerful; allows changing critical system behavior. Requires root or ADB.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
description: Provides approximate location based on network sources.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
description: Provides precise device location via GPS and network.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
description: Allows apps to access device location in the background.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
description: Allows location tracking while running a foreground service (shows a notification).

name: android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
description: Allows detection of physical activities like walking, running, cycling, or driving.

name: com.google.android.gms.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
description: Google Play Services version of activity recognition; previous version may be deprecated.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
description: Allows access to Wi-Fi state; can be used for tracking via SSID and signal strengths.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
description: Allows monitoring of network connections.

name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
description: Allows changing Wi-Fi state; requires user consent.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
description: Allows recording audio while running in a foreground service.

name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA
description: Allows camera access while running a foreground service.

name: android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY
description: Allows access to notification settings; can alter DND or monitor sleeping patterns.

name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
description: Allows the app to start automatically when the device boots; can be used for persistence.

name: android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
description: Allows bypassing battery optimizations; useful for background persistence.

name: android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
description: Allows app to uninstall other apps; could be used maliciously.
